refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The SilikoInputAdvance function advances object to the next character of input by calling the advance function of object’s SilikoInputVTable. object must be a value returned by SilikoInputCreate.

refsection.title: Return Values
refsection.para: SiikoInputAdvance returns the return value of the call to the advance function of the passed SilikoDataSource object: true if the object has more characters to read, or false if the object is exhausted.
